AssetCase.description:
The type table of an asset-producing test case whose only key is the asset it
targets: `[blender]`, `[particle]`, `[music]` and `[audio-fx]`.

id.description: The id of the asset under `assets/` the model produces.

dir.description:
The folder, relative to the suite tree. Its last segment is the
asset's id.

AssetManifest.description:
`assets/<asset-id>/asset.toml`: one bundled asset of the suite's finished
asset set.

Every path it names is relative to the asset's own folder and resolves inside
it, so an asset folder stays self-contained.

files.description: The asset's files, relative to the asset folder. At least one.

id.description:
Kebab-case identity, unique across the suite and identical to the folder
name.

kind.description: The asset's format, which is also the test case type that produces it.

name.description: The display name used wherever the asset is presented.

specification.description:
The `id` of the specification describing this asset, resolved suite-wide.
The value is the id itself and carries no separators.

BuildCommands.description: The `[build]` table: the commands producing the served static build.

DebugApiFunction.description: A `[[function]]` table: one query or command on a debug API module.

description.description: What a query reports, or what a command changes.

kind.description: Whether the function reports state or changes it.

name.description: The property name the function is called by, unique within its module.

parameter.description:
The parameters worth describing, as repeated `[[function.parameter]]`
tables.

signature.description:
The function's TypeScript signature, carried as a string and copied
through verbatim into the generated declaration.

DebugApiFunctionKind.description: Whether a debug API function reads state or writes it.

oneOf.description: Reports state and leaves the implementation unchanged.

Changes state and reports nothing. Its effect is immediate and complete
when it returns.

DebugApiModule.description:
A debug API module: `debug-api.toml` at the root of the version folder, or one
of the `debug-api/<path>.toml` files it references.

One type serves both, with `handle` present only at the root. The root object
is what the implementation sets on `globalThis`, and validators reach the whole
tree through it.

function.description: The functions this module defines, as repeated `[[function]]` tables.

handle.description:
The `globalThis` property name the implementation sets the root object on.
Declared by `debug-api.toml` alone.

module.description:
The child modules this module reaches, as repeated `[[module]]` tables. A
module declaring one is an interior node; a module declaring only
functions is a leaf.

DebugApiModuleRef.description:
A `[[module]]` table: the reference from a parent module to the file declaring
a child. Each module file is referenced by exactly one parent, so the files
form the same tree the debug API does.

name.description: The property name the module is reached by on its parent.

path.description: The file declaring it, relative to the suite tree.

DebugApiParameter.description:
A `[[function.parameter]]` table: one documented parameter of a debug API
function.

name.description: The parameter's name, as it appears in the signature.

dir.description: The folder, relative to the suite tree.

DemoManifest.description:
`demos/<slug>/demo.toml`: one demonstration, a short self-contained Vite
project showing a single mechanic in practice.

id.description: Kebab-case identity, matching the demonstration's directory name.

name.description: The display name shown wherever the demonstration is presented.

specification.description:
The `id` of the specification whose mechanic this demonstrates, which is
what binds a demonstration to what it illustrates.

summary.description: A one-line abstract, authored inline as plain text.

ShowcaseManifest.description:
`showcase/showcase.toml`: the ordered carousel of a showcase directory.

This is the shared showcase format — the run, case and suite showcases are one
format, so this type is the manifest of all three. The bounds that go with it
are shared too: the description is capped at
[`MAX_SHOWCASE_DESCRIPTION_BYTES`](crate::MAX_SHOWCASE_DESCRIPTION_BYTES), the
carousel at [`MAX_SHOWCASE_MEDIA_ENTRIES`](crate::MAX_SHOWCASE_MEDIA_ENTRIES),
and each media file at
[`MAX_SHOWCASE_MEDIA_FILE_BYTES`](crate::MAX_SHOWCASE_MEDIA_FILE_BYTES).

Unknown keys are tolerated: a run-side manifest is model-written, and a stray
extra key is not worth losing the whole showcase over.

media.description:
The carousel, as repeated `[[media]]` tables. Table order is carousel
order.

file.description:
The media file's name in the showcase directory itself. A plain file name,
so it carries no path separators.

name.description: The short caption displayed with the entry.

SpecificationFolder.description:
One specification folder: its manifest, the prose beside it, and the
specification folders nested inside it.

children.description:
The specification folders nested inside this one. Specification folders
nest freely.

dir.description: The folder, relative to the suite tree.

prose.description:
The declared path of `specification.md`, relative to the suite tree.
The prose itself is referenced rather than held, and a save leaves its
bytes alone.

SpecificationManifest.description:
`specifications/<name>/specification.toml`: one specification and the ordered
requirements derived from its prose.

id.description:
Kebab-case identity, unique among every specification in the suite
including nested ones.

name.description: The display name used wherever the specification is presented.

path.description:
Where the rendered specification is seeded in the run workspace, relative
to `specs/`.

requirement.description:
The requirements, in the order they are presented. Emitted as repeated
`[[requirement]]` tables.

summary.description: A single inline plain-text line describing what the specification covers.

SpriteCase.description: The `[sprite]` table of a sprite test case definition.

id.description: The id of the asset under `assets/` the model produces.

sheet.description: Whether the produced asset is a sprite sheet rather than a single sprite.

SuiteAssetKind.description: What an asset holds, and the test case type that produces it.

oneOf.description: A single 2D sprite image.
A 2D sprite sheet for one entity.
A voxel model, optionally with rigid-body animation.
A model authored through Blender's Python API.
A particle system read by the particle runtime.
A musical score.
A short, non-musical audio effect.

SuiteDebugApi.description: The debug API tree: the root module and every module file the version holds.

modules.description:
The module files under `debug-api/`, keyed by their path relative to the
version folder — which is exactly the string a parent's `[[module]]`
table names.

SuiteDifficulty.description: How hard a test case is.

oneOf.description: The least demanding tier.
The middle tier.
The most demanding tier.

SuiteManifest.description:
`<slug>/suite.toml`: a suite's identity, declared once for the whole suite.

It sits at the root of the suite folder rather than inside any suite tree, so
every draft and every exported version of the suite shares it, and renaming the
suite renames each of them.

name.description:
The display name shown wherever the suite is presented, including for each
of its exported versions.

slug.description: The suite's stable identity: a kebab-case token matching the suite folder.

SuiteRequirement.description: One `[[requirement]]` of a specification, written in RFC 2119 style.

id.description:
Kebab-case identity, unique within the file. Requirement identity across
the suite is `<specification id>/<requirement id>`.

kind.description: Whether the requirement is decided by a validator or by review.

text.description:
The requirement statement, a complete RFC 2119 sentence with the keyword
capitalized inside it.

validators.description:
Validator module paths relative to `validators/`, each naming a `.ts` file
exporting a validator function. A functional requirement declares one or
more; a non-functional one declares none.

oneOf.description:
Decided by the validators the requirement claims. Every functional
requirement must be satisfied, and a validator either passes or fails.

Judged by review rather than by a test result, so it declares no
validators. Appearance requirements are of this kind.

SuiteShowcase.description:
The suite showcase: the carousel, and the declared path of the prose beside
it.

description.description: The declared path of `showcase.md`, relative to the suite tree.

media.description:
The media files sitting in the showcase directory, relative to the version
folder.

SuiteTestCaseDefinition.description:
`test-cases/<name>.toml`: one individually runnable segment of the suite.

The file stem is the definition's slug. Every path a definition names is
relative to the suite tree.

audio-fx.description: The `[audio-fx]` table, carried by an `audio-fx` definition.

blender.description: The `[blender]` table, carried by a `blender` definition.

build.description:
`[build]`: the commands that turn the produced implementation into the
served static build the validators run against.

difficulty.description: The difficulty of this test case.

engines.description:
The engine slugs a run may select one entry from. Declared by the
code-producing types; empty on the others.

experimental.description:
Whether the definition is kept out of the catalog for deployments that
have not opted in.

init.description:
The command run inside the run container once the workspace and
specifications are seeded and before the harness starts. `None` runs no
init step. Must not be blank when declared.

max_runtime_hours.description: The cap on the session in hours. A run exceeding it is stopped.

music.description: The `[music]` table, carried by a `music` definition.

name.description: The display name shown wherever the test case is listed.

particle.description: The `[particle]` table, carried by a `particle` definition.

prompt.description:
The Handlebars template under the version folder whose rendering is handed
to the harness.

specifications.description:
The specification ids this test case covers. `None` — the key omitted —
covers every specification in the suite, which is why an absent key is not
the same value as an empty list.

sprite.description: The `[sprite]` table, carried by a `sprite` definition.

toolchain.description:
`[toolchain]`: the TypeScript commands run over the produced
implementation.

type.description: The test case type, which decides which type table the definition carries.

voxel.description: The `[voxel]` table, carried by a `voxel` definition.

workspaces.description:
`[workspaces]`: one entry per engine the definition declares, mapping an
engine slug to the starter workspace seeded at the run root. Declared by
the code-producing types.

slug.description: The file stem, which is the definition's slug.

SuiteTestCaseType.description:
The kind of test case a definition declares.

The `performance`, `adversarial` and `puzzle` forms are specified as TBD on
their documentation page: the model carries their `type` value and their common
keys, and declares no type table for them.

oneOf.description:
Purely code-focused: the model is given every asset it needs plus the
specifications describing what to write.

The model generates its own assets and writes the code implementing the
specifications.
The model produces one sprite or one sprite sheet.
The model produces a boxel-style model, optionally animated.
The model authors an asset through Blender's Python API.
The model authors a particle effect the particle runtime plays.
The model authors a musical score.
The model authors short, non-musical audio.

The model writes Rust measured by the wasmtime fuel it consumes. TBD: the
definition keys are specified against performance testing.

The model writes an AI controller run head-to-head against other models'.
TBD: the definition keys are specified against adversarial testing.
TBD: the test suite form of puzzle test cases is not yet specified.

SuiteTrees.description:
The paths of the trees a version folder holds that are not TOML entities.

They are recorded rather than parsed: what a reader needs from them is which
files are there, and the files themselves belong to the toolchains that
consume them.

prompts.description: Every file under `prompts/`, relative to the suite tree.

reference_implementations.description:
The reference implementations, keyed by the engine folder name under
`reference-implementations/`, each holding that project's files relative
to the suite tree.

shared_demos.description:
Every file under `demos/shared/`, the TypeScript library the
demonstrations depend on, relative to the suite tree.

validators.description:
Every file under `validators/`, relative to the suite tree. The Vitest
project rooted there holds the validator modules and their own tests.

workspaces.description:
The starter workspaces, keyed by the workspace slug under `workspaces/`,
each holding that workspace's files relative to the suite tree.

ToolchainCommands.description:
The `[toolchain]` table: the TypeScript commands run over the produced
implementation.

format.description: Format-checks the implementation. Recorded rather than gating.

lint.description: Lints the implementation. Recorded rather than gating.

test.description: Runs the implementation's own tests. Recorded rather than gating.

typecheck.description:
Typechecks the implementation. Required, and a non-zero exit rates the run
broken.

VersionManifest.description:
`version.toml`: what distinguishes one suite tree, and the prose presenting it.

Every path it names is relative to the suite tree and resolves inside it, so a
suite tree stays self-contained.

changelog.description:
The relative path of the Markdown file recording what changed in this
version.

description.description: The relative path of the Markdown file describing the suite.

experimental.description:
Whether the version is still being iterated on. A deployment offers an
experimental version only when it opts in.

summary.description: A one-line abstract, authored inline as plain text.

tags.description: Classification tags, for filtering. Empty when the key is omitted.

version.description:
The suite version in semver form, matching the name of the exported
version folder with its leading `v` removed. Export writes it, and a draft
omits it.

VoxelCase.description: The `[voxel]` table of a voxel test case definition.

animated.description: Whether rigid-body animation of the produced model is required.

id.description: The id of the asset under `assets/` the model produces.

description:
One whole suite tree: the suite it belongs to, every entity the tree declares,
and the paths of the trees that hold no TOML.

assets.description: The bundled assets under `assets/`, one per folder.

debug_api.description:
The debug API, when the version declares one. A version declaring no test
case whose subject is a model-written build declares none.

demos.description: The demonstrations under `demos/`, one per folder.

manifest.description: `version.toml`: the version's identity and the prose describing it.

showcase.description: The showcase, when the version holds one.

specifications.description:
The specification folders under `specifications/`, nested as they are on
disk.

suite.description:
`suite.toml`: the identity of the suite this tree belongs to. It is read from
the suite folder rather than from the tree, so a save of the tree leaves it
alone.

test_cases.description: The test case definitions under `test-cases/`, one per file.

trees.description: The trees the model references but does not hold.
